summary: P01 V2.47.230 is the Frontstage-first daily operation closure accumulated after V2.47.225. It keeps the existing canonical authorities and moves frequent reversible interaction into frontstage: Navigation category ordering plus direct basic category create/rename/reparent/delete over existing category_save/category_delete/category_reorder + Recycle Bin; browser/quick-save Pending becomes a first-class Navigation inbox with browser-source/newest priority and direct canonical organize; Projects keeps Owner-scoped Git sync available in frontstage; Tools placement uses existing ToolboxConfig/settings presentation authority; Software install-plan ordering remains browser-local. Stable RPD/SSOT/Functional Contract/Acceptance UX-48..UX-51 were updated. No Schema/Migration, no second data authority, no auth/session/security semantic change, no updater mechanism change, no provider/server write and no Production write. Owner explicitly requires release-through-upgrade without temporary Preview; Production remains Owner-manual.
